models.name: rtmdet-nano
models.description: RTMDet-nano person detector (COCO person class 0), ONNX. From OpenMMLab rtmpose-cpu SDK. Input 320x320, outputs [1,100,5] (x1,y1,x2,y2,score) + [1,100] labels. Apache-2.0 — commercial friendly (docs/model-licenses.md).

models.name: rtmpose-light
models.description: RTMPose-S body keypoint model (COCO 17 keypoints), ONNX. Body7 training. Apache-2.0 — commercial friendly (docs/model-licenses.md).

models.name: motionbert
models.description: MotionBERT 3D lifting backend (Apache-2.0). ONNX export pending — do not install yet; backend lands in a follow-up change.
